vi.L: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phán với thiên sứ, và thiên sứ tra gươm vào vỏ.
vi.B: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ra lệnh cho thiên sứ, và thiên sứ tra gươm vào vỏ.
vi.R: Bấy giờ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ra lệnh cho thiên sứ, và thiên sứ cất gươm đi.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 천사에게 말씀하셨고, 그가 자기 칼을 칼집에 도로 꽂았다.
ko.B: 그때 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 천사에게 명령하셨고, 천사는 자기 칼을 칼집에 도로 꽂았다.
ko.R: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 천사에게 명령하시자, 천사는 칼을 거두었다.

pt.L: E {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} falou ao anjo, e ele pôs de volta a sua espada na bainha.
pt.B: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu uma ordem ao anjo, e o anjo pôs a espada de volta na bainha.
pt.R: Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu uma ordem ao anjo, e o anjo guardou a sua espada.

decisions.choice: the angel sheathes his sword: a verse not in 2 Samuel 24
decisions.reason: In 2 Samuel 24:16 Yahweh tells the angel, "Now let your hand drop", and the story does not mention a sword. Here the sword David saw drawn over Jerusalem (verse 16) goes back into its sheath, and so the judgment is over.

decisions.choice: spoke to: gave an order to
decisions.reason: The verb is the ordinary word for "said"; what Yahweh says to the angel is a command, as the angel's obedience shows.

decisions.choice: gave the angel a command; the angel put his sword back
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what kind of speaking this was and name the angel as the one who put the sword away.

source.text: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֔יא בִּרְא֤וֹת דָּוִיד֙ כִּי־עָנָ֣הוּ יְהוָ֔ה בְּגֹ֖רֶן אָרְנָ֣ן הַיְבוּסִ֑י וַיִּזְבַּ֖ח שָֽׁם׃

records.literal_gloss: At the time the that, when saw David that had answered him Yahweh at [the] threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, and he sacrificed there.

en.L: At that time, when David saw that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he sacrificed there.
en.B: At that time, when David saw that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had given him an answer at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered his sacrifices there.
en.R: David saw that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} had answered his prayer at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite. So at that time he offered sacrifices there.

es.L: En aquel tiempo, al ver David que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había respondido en la era de Ornán el jebuseo, ofreció sacrificios allí.
es.B: En aquel tiempo, cuando David vio que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le había respondido en la era de Ornán el jebuseo, ofreció allí sus sacrificios.
es.R: David vio que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había respondido a su oración en la era de Ornán el jebuseo. Por eso, en aquel tiempo, ofreció sacrificios allí.

fr.L: En ce temps-là, quand David vit que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait répondu sur l’aire d’Ornân le Jébusien, il y offrit des sacrifices.
fr.B: À ce moment-là, quand David vit que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui avait répondu sur l’aire d’Ornân le Jébusien, il y offrit ses sacrifices.
fr.R: David a vu que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avait répondu à sa prière sur l’aire d’Ornân le Jébusien. Alors, à ce moment-là, il y a offert des sacrifices.

sw.L: Wakati huo, Daudi alipoona kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amemjibu katika uwanja wa kupuria wa Ornani Myebusi, akatoa dhabihu huko.
sw.B: Wakati huo, Daudi alipoona kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amempa jibu katika uwanja wa kupuria wa Ornani Myebusi, akatoa dhabihu zake huko.
sw.R: Daudi aliona kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amejibu maombi yake katika uwanja wa kupuria wa Ornani Myebusi. Kwa hiyo wakati huo akatoa dhabihu huko.

vi.L: Vào lúc ấy, khi Đa-vít thấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đáp lời ông tại sân đập lúa của Ọt-nan người Giê-bu-sít, thì ông dâng sinh tế tại đó.
vi.B: Vào lúc ấy, khi Đa-vít thấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã đáp lời ông tại sân đập lúa của Ọt-nan người Giê-bu-sít, ông dâng các sinh tế tại đó.
vi.R: Đa-vít thấy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã nhậm lời cầu nguyện của ông tại sân đập lúa của Ọt-nan người Giê-bu-sít. Vì vậy lúc ấy ông dâng sinh tế tại đó.

ko.L: 그때 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여부스 사람 오르난의 타작마당에서 자기에게 응답하신 것을 보고, 거기에서 제사를 드렸다.
ko.B: 그때 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여부스 사람 오르난의 타작마당에서 자기에게 응답하신 것을 보고, 거기에서 제사를 드렸다.
ko.R: 다윗은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 여부스 사람 오르난의 타작마당에서 자기 기도에 응답하신 것을 알았다. 그래서 그때 그는 거기에서 제사를 드렸다.

pt.L: Naquele tempo, quando Davi viu que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe tinha respondido na eira de Ornã, o jebuseu, sacrificou ali.
pt.B: Naquela ocasião, quando Davi viu que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe tinha dado resposta na eira de Ornã, o jebuseu, ofereceu ali os seus sacrifícios.
pt.R: Davi viu que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} tinha respondido à sua oração na eira de Ornã, o jebuseu. Por isso, naquela ocasião, ele ofereceu sacrifícios ali.

decisions.choice: verses 28-30: the Chronicler's own comment, not in 2 Samuel 24
decisions.reason: Here the story stops and the writer explains why David went on offering sacrifices at Ornan's threshing floor rather than at the tabernacle. The explanation leads to David's words in 22:1: "This is the house of Yahweh God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel."

decisions.choice: at that time ... he sacrificed there: David's sacrifices after the answer
decisions.reason: "At that time" ties the sentence to the fire from heaven (verse 26). Seeing that Yahweh had answered him at that place, David made it his place of sacrifice.

decisions.choice: offered sacrifices; given him an answer (Balanced); answered his prayer (Readable)
decisions.reason: The verb means to slaughter animals in sacrifice. Balanced and Readable use the usual English phrase. Readable says what Yahweh answered: David's call in verse 26.

decisions.choice: David saw ... So at that time ...
decisions.reason: Readable puts the cause in its own sentence first.

source.text: וּמִשְׁכַּ֣ן יְ֠הוָה אֲשֶׁר־עָשָׂ֨ה מֹשֶׁ֧ה בַמִּדְבָּ֛ר וּמִזְבַּ֥ח הָעוֹלָ֖ה בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֑יא בַּבָּמָ֖ה בְּגִבְעֽוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] tabernacle of Yahweh which made Moses in the wilderness, and [the] altar of the burnt offering, [were] at the time the that in [the] high place at Gibeon.

en.L: Now the tabernacle of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering [were] at that time at the high place at Gibeon.
en.B: Now at that time the tabernacle of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, made by Moses in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering were at the high place in Gibeon.
en.R: At that time the tabernacle of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the tent that Moses had made in the wilderness, was at the hilltop shrine in Gibeon. The altar for burnt offerings was there too.

es.L: Y el tabernáculo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que Moisés había hecho en el desierto, y el altar del holocausto [estaban] en aquel tiempo en el lugar alto de Gabaón.
es.B: En aquel tiempo el tabernáculo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que Moisés había hecho en el desierto, y el altar del holocausto estaban en el lugar alto de Gabaón.
es.R: En aquel tiempo el tabernáculo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, la tienda que Moisés había hecho en el desierto, estaba en el santuario sobre la colina de Gabaón. El altar de los holocaustos también estaba allí.

fr.L: Or la Demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, que Moïse avait faite dans le désert, et l’autel de l’holocauste [étaient] en ce temps-là au haut lieu de Gabaon.
fr.B: Or, en ce temps-là, la Demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, faite par Moïse dans le désert, et l’autel des holocaustes se trouvaient au haut lieu de Gabaon.
fr.R: À ce moment-là, la Demeure {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, la tente que Moïse avait faite dans le désert, se trouvait au sanctuaire sur la colline de Gabaon. L’autel des holocaustes s’y trouvait aussi.

sw.L: Maskani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyoifanya Musa jangwani, na madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa, [vilikuwa] wakati huo mahali pa juu huko Gibeoni.
sw.B: Wakati huo maskani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, iliyofanywa na Musa jangwani, na madhabahu ya sadaka ya kuteketezwa vilikuwa mahali pa juu huko Gibeoni.
sw.R: Wakati huo maskani ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, yaani hema ambalo Musa alilitengeneza jangwani, ilikuwa katika patakatifu pa kilimani huko Gibeoni. Madhabahu ya sadaka za kuteketezwa nayo ilikuwa huko.

vi.L: Lúc ấy đền tạm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà Môi-se đã làm trong hoang mạc, và bàn thờ dâng của lễ thiêu, [đang ở] tại nơi cao ở Ga-ba-ôn.
vi.B: Lúc ấy đền tạm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, do Môi-se làm trong hoang mạc, và bàn thờ dâng của lễ thiêu đang ở tại nơi cao ở Ga-ba-ôn.
vi.R: Lúc ấy đền tạm của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, là cái lều mà Môi-se đã làm trong hoang mạc, đang ở tại nơi thờ phượng trên đồi cao ở Ga-ba-ôn. Bàn thờ dâng của lễ thiêu cũng ở đó.

ko.L: 그리고 모세가 광야에서 만든 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성막과 번제단은 그때 기브온의 산당에 [있었다].
ko.B: 그때 모세가 광야에서 만든 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성막과 번제단은 기브온의 산당에 있었다.
ko.R: 그때 모세가 광야에서 만든 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성막, 곧 거룩한 천막은 기브온의 산꼭대기 제단에 있었다. 번제단도 그곳에 있었다.

pt.L: Mas o tabernáculo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que Moisés fez no deserto, e o altar do holocausto [estavam] naquele tempo no alto em Gibeom.
pt.B: Naquele tempo, o tabernáculo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, feito por Moisés no deserto, e o altar do holocausto estavam no alto de Gibeom.
pt.R: Naquela época, o tabernáculo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, a tenda que Moisés tinha feito no deserto, estava no santuário no alto do morro, em Gibeom. O altar dos holocaustos também estava lá.

decisions.choice: the tabernacle at Gibeon: where the official worship took place
decisions.reason: 1 Chronicles 16:39-40 says David left the priest Zadok at the tabernacle at the high place in Gibeon to offer the daily burnt offerings, while the ark was in Jerusalem. Solomon went there to sacrifice at the start of his reign (1 Kings 3:4; 2 Chronicles 1:3-6). This verse is not in 2 Samuel 24.

decisions.choice: the high place at Gibeon: a hilltop place of worship a few miles northwest of Jerusalem
decisions.reason: A high place was a raised site for worship. Gibeon was a town of Benjamin (Joshua 18:25). Here the high place is the lawful site of the tabernacle, not a pagan shrine.

decisions.choice: Now the tabernacle ...: background that explains verse 28
decisions.reason: The sentence begins with its subject, not with a verb, which marks it as an explanation set beside the story. It tells why David's sacrifice at Ornan's threshing floor needs explaining: the lawful altar was at Gibeon.

decisions.choice: the tent that Moses had made; the hilltop shrine
decisions.reason: Readable explains "tabernacle" as a tent and says "hilltop shrine" for "high place", as elsewhere in these books.

decisions.choice: o tabernáculo; o alto (L, B), o santuário no alto do morro (R); Gibeom
decisions.reason: "O tabernáculo" for the mishkan, as the terms list; "o alto" at Literal and Balanced and a description at Readable for the high place, here the lawful site (m2), as 1 Kings 3:4 in Portuguese has it at Gibeon ("o grande alto", "santuários no alto dos morros"); "Gibeom" as there.

source.text: וְלֹא־יָכֹ֥ל דָּוִ֛יד לָלֶ֥כֶת לְפָנָ֖יו לִדְרֹ֣שׁ אֱלֹהִ֑ים כִּ֣י נִבְעַ֔ת מִפְּנֵ֕י חֶ֖רֶב מַלְאַ֥ךְ יְהוָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And not was able David to go before it to seek God, for he was terrified from before [the] sword of [the] angel of Yahweh.

en.L: But David could not go before it to seek God, for he was terrified because of the sword of the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: But David could not go there to seek God, because he was terrified of the sword of the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: But David could not go there to ask God for help, because he was afraid of the angel of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} and his sword.

es.L: Pero David no podía ir delante de él para buscar a Dios, porque estaba aterrado a causa de la espada del ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Pero David no podía ir allá a buscar a Dios, porque estaba aterrado por la espada del ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Pero David no podía ir allá a pedirle ayuda a Dios, porque tenía miedo del ángel {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} y de su espada.

fr.L: Mais David ne pouvait pas aller devant elle pour consulter Dieu, car il était terrifié à cause de l’épée de l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Mais David ne pouvait pas s’y rendre pour consulter Dieu, car l’épée de l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} l’avait terrifié.
fr.R: Mais David ne pouvait pas y aller pour demander l’aide de Dieu, parce qu’il avait peur de l’ange {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} et de son épée.

sw.L: Lakini Daudi hakuweza kwenda mbele yake kumtafuta Mungu, kwa maana aliogopa sana kwa sababu ya upanga wa malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Lakini Daudi hakuweza kwenda huko kumtafuta Mungu, kwa sababu aliuogopa sana upanga wa malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Lakini Daudi hakuweza kwenda huko kumwomba Mungu msaada, kwa sababu alimwogopa malaika wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na upanga wake.

vi.L: Nhưng Đa-vít không thể đến trước bàn thờ ấy để tìm cầu Đức Chúa Trời, vì ông kinh hãi trước gươm của thiên sứ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Nhưng Đa-vít không thể đến đó để tìm cầu Đức Chúa Trời, vì ông kinh hãi gươm của thiên sứ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Nhưng Đa-vít không thể đến đó để cầu xin Đức Chúa Trời giúp đỡ, vì ông sợ thiên sứ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} và thanh gươm của thiên sứ.

ko.L: 그러나 다윗은 그 앞에 가서 하나님께 구할 수 없었다. 그가 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사의 칼 때문에 두려워 떨었기 때문이다.
ko.B: 그러나 다윗은 그곳에 가서 하나님께 구할 수 없었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사의 칼이 무서웠기 때문이다.
ko.R: 그러나 다윗은 그곳에 가서 하나님께 도움을 구할 수 없었다. 그는 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 천사와 그의 칼이 무서웠기 때문이다.

pt.L: Mas Davi não podia ir diante dele para buscar a Deus, porque estava aterrorizado por causa da espada do anjo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Mas Davi não podia ir lá para buscar a Deus, porque estava aterrorizado com a espada do anjo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Mas Davi não podia ir lá para procurar a ajuda de Deus, porque tinha medo do anjo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} e da sua espada.

decisions.choice: David afraid of the angel's sword: not in 2 Samuel 24
decisions.reason: This explanation is the Chronicler's own. The sword is the one David saw drawn over Jerusalem (verse 16).

decisions.choice: to seek God: to turn to God in worship and ask his will
decisions.reason: "Seek" is a key word in Chronicles for turning to God in trust and worship (10:13-14; 13:3). David could not go to Gibeon to do this, so he worshiped where God had answered him.

decisions.choice: go before it: go to the tabernacle and its altar at Gibeon
decisions.reason: "It" points back to the tabernacle and altar of verse 29. The text does not say exactly why fear of the angel kept David from the journey; it may be that he did not dare leave the place where the angel had stopped, or that the terror still held him.

decisions.choice: go there
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "go there" for "go before it": to the tabernacle at Gibeon.

decisions.choice: to ask God for help
decisions.reason: Readable says what seeking God means in plain words, as at 10:14.

decisions.choice: buscar a Deus (L, B); procurar a ajuda de Deus (R)
decisions.reason: The Chronicler's verb for turning to God (m2) keeps the words of 10:13-14 in Portuguese: "buscar" at Literal and Balanced, "procurar a ajuda de" at Readable.
